Confirmed: Florida DMV Breached After Criminals Exploit Police Credentials
summary:
Florida's highway safety agency confirmed a data breach by an international cybercriminal organization discovered on September 4th. Investigators say the actor used a Plant City Police Department user's credentials improperly stored on a personal device. The agency says the breach was quickly stopped and has notified state authorities.
The post Confirmed: Florida DMV Breached After Criminals Exploit Police Credentials appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Florida's highway safety agency has confirmed a data breach carried out by an international cybercriminal organization. According to investigators, the attackers gained unauthorized access by exploiting police credentials improperly stored on a personal device. Authorities stated that the security incident was quickly contained and state officials have been properly notified of the breach.
